title: Summit One provisional problem-type taxonomy
purpose: Tag and schedule existing AMC and Rossmoyne content under ONE daily student journey, NOT 12 independent streams.

scope.limits: Existing app source bank not accessible; no exhaustive classification of current live app. AMC Q26-Q30 selected sample is not representative of Q1-Q25.

categories.name: Number sense, place value and digit puzzles

subskills.name: Digit sums and counting digits in ranges
Parts and wholes, including remaining fractions
Relative speeds, timed movement and meetings
Winner margins, shared totals and linear rules
Doubling, geometric growth and finite sums
Magic grids, symbolic rules and consistency
Proving all cases and unique solutions
Perimeter, shared edges and boundary effects
Optimising areas and lengths under constraints
Painted faces, boundary and hidden cubes
Nets, surface area, volume and 3D views
Averages, weighted means and simple distributions

universal_strategies.name: Choose a useful model: draw, tabulate, graph, or write an equation
Work backwards from the requested result
Try small cases and generalise the pattern
Partition possibilities into exhaustive non-overlapping cases
Count the complement or remove an overlap
Find an invariant, conserved total or unchanged difference
Count the same quantity in two ways
Exploit symmetry or transform to a simpler equivalent
Reduce by parity, divisibility, remainders or cycles
Use bounds/optimisation and verify the final answer independently

interpretation.exact_recurrence: Seven identical normalized transcribed question texts across Middle/Upper sets, all within a single year; do not interpret as repeated across different years.
interpretation.concept_recurrence: Many shared techniques and structurally similar constructions across years; study methods not scripts.
interpretation.strict_accuracy: Primary topic classification is judgemental, especially multi-skill problems. Diagram dependent entries require human review. No automatic readiness prediction.
